title: Snowden's revelations about Bullrun and PRISM

tellings.quote: we know we know from Snowden they had back doors they Bull run and prism and I don't think this was done unbeknownst to Google and Apple

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, recalls that in 2013 Edward Snowden, a former US intelligence contractor, revealed Bullrun and PRISM, secret government programmes that he says gave spies back doors into technology. Michels says he doesn't believe this happened without Google and Apple knowing, and he uses it to argue that big companies can quietly keep government secrets.
